t: The Forge Steel 101-piece multi-material drill and screwdriver bit set offers a comprehensive range of power tool accessories for various drilling and screwdriving applications. This versatile kit is suitable for trade professionals working on diverse materials such as wood, masonry, and metal, making it an essential addition to any job site. The set includes tough titanium nitride coated high-speed steel drill bits for effective drilling in soft steel and non-ferrous metals, and features impact-resistant tungsten carbide-tipped bits for fast drilling and extended life. The brad point wood drill bits ensure precise starting and a smooth finish by reducing splintering. All pieces are supplied in the robust blow-moulded case, ensuring organised storage and transport.
